scope: scripts/qualify_hardware_changes.py --slice refusals on Debug builds of main c4fe913d (after #250's #221 fix: network_io_assign with expectedServerModule skips the baseline compile; every other compiling change compares against its own baseline compile) in owned scratch projects created through the MCP Host, one owned TIA Portal V21 Update 3 each. 199/199 steps: the same two-project corpus as local.hardware_changes.refusals.20261102 (address-change replacement with an acknowledged tag, sharedDevice disconnect, OutsideOfProject in both projects, MRP, PLC-to-PLC and capability-profile refusals).
limitations: Engineering only, offline: nothing is downloaded, no PLCSIM, no physical topology or MRP telegram is observed.
A versionless firmware matching no profile (fail closed) is not exercised natively: the installed GSD has one DAP with one firmware (offline tests cover it).

The sharedDevice disconnect with one remaining PLC and one assigned module; more remaining PLCs are refused and not exercised. The disconnect, the address change and the shared device are restored, not persisted across a reopen (the slice has no reopen).

Second project: V21 checks nothing across projects; the runner compares the two stations. Head, interface, ports and server module stay assigned in both projects, which a downloaded configuration would have to resolve; SharedDeviceCopyOfModule is not configured.
The address change rewrites no tag address and does not search absolute %I/%Q accesses in program code.

Earlier pass, not evidence: artifacts/hr/hw_347798a0 stopped at a change_restore of the same build on a transient 'Access to the path ... recovery ... before was denied' file lock; the rerun passed unchanged.
A rerun after the #221 baseline-compile change on the current build; it repeats, and does not widen, the scope of local.hardware_changes.refusals.20261102.
